en.title: The Village of the Mirror Mark
en.premise: Returning to his ancestral village following his grandmother's death, the protagonist discovers an old letter hidden beneath the floorboards. It bears a desperate warning: 'During the festival, never look into a mirror.' But as the true nature of the villagers' sacred 'Mirroring Ritual' is revealed, he realizes with growing dread that his own reflection is silently transforming within the glass.

zh.title: 镜痣之村
zh.premise: 祖母去世后，主人公回到了故乡的小村庄。在那里，他在地板下发现了一封被藏匿的旧信，信中写着一条令人胆寒的警告：“祭典期间，绝不可窥视镜中之物。”然而，当他得知村民们所信仰的“镜像仪式”的真相时，他惊觉镜中的自己，正悄然发生着诡异的变异。
